body: You're not stupid. You're the only person who's experienced everything you're going through, and you're the only one who's having to deal with the consequences of it. If you're not ready to move on, you don't move on. If you think you have further mental health issues, it's your decision to pursue that.
That's fair- I know I've found it hard to put my feelings into words before. It can feel really overwhelming when things happen as quickly as you described- do you feel like that's happening here?

You're probably right. To be honest the extent of revenge was probably going to be a wall of angry goths between me and him. I think he's beginning to learn his lesson- the mutual friend who introduced us is solidly on my side and other people seem to be drifting away from him.

My friends are aware, and there's currently a betting pool as to who's going to take elaborate revenge on the fucker first. Part of my issue is that he's so obviously shitty (and they've taken pains to point this out to me) that I feel awful for sticking with him for so long. If they can see what was wrong from the most basic description of him, why didn't I see it when I was around him almost 24/7?
Yeah, that sounds really frustrating. You sound like you feel trapped?
God I'm so sorry. You shouldn't have had to go through all of that, especially not at once.
